# api-gateway

> FastAPI reverse proxy with circuit breakers, timeouts, correlation IDs, and CORS. Single entry point (port 8000) routing to 6 downstream services.

## Docs

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): Architecture, endpoints, and testing posture for the API Gateway.

## Source

- Entrypoint: `services/api-gateway/gateway/main.py`
- Config: `services/api-gateway/gateway/config.py`
- Circuit breaker: `services/api-gateway/gateway/circuit_breaker.py`
- Tests: `services/api-gateway/tests/`
